scope: G07-A02/A08 aggregate private recovery measurement helper, not recovery/work-bound acceptance

independentTests.labels: Pure call/clock/transport fixtures and actual official pagination over synthetic log rows; no native DB/browser/proof/encrypted recovery.

sourceInspection: Fixed phase/method vocabulary, own-data descriptor array lengths and safe numeric aggregates; no owner/tag/log contents, error/cause/stack, SDK serialization or history retained.

Single Reflect.apply preserves receiver/argument identity, original primitive/object/Promise return, sync throw and rejected error identity; observer catches metadata/clock failure and reports gap without replacing original operation.
Native promise then observation bypasses overridden then; throwing constructor/species path marked unobserved, original Promise returned; opaque thenables never assimilated.
Counts/timings are bounded/saturating with unhealthy flag, snapshots detached, absent discovery/fold phases remain unobserved.
Installed actual getPrivateLogsByTags/getPublicLogsByTags API returns nested arrays; official tag-page helper tested21/41rows across multiple pages.
Caller alone supplies already-serialized byte counts and process memory; helper adds no response stream reads/retries/services/lifecycle/store mutation.

integrationRequirements: Wrap only parent-owned facades with actual this binding; do not patch SDK prototypes/private stores/queues or create separate lifecycle owners.

Parent must identify actual supported hooks and retain unknown/unsupported status. Inclusive head utility/event duration does not separately measure encrypted discovery; do not fill discovery/fold counters from invented callbacks.
Validate observerHealthy and settled plus individual required phase/method observations; transportBytesObserved and wireCountsMatch alone are not coverage proof.

wireCountsMatch compares global aggregate call/record totals, not per-method agreement; parent must independently reconcile per-method wire/call inventories if claiming transport coverage (cache hits can legitimately differ).
Memory is sampled process RSS/heap, not descendant-tree bound; existing supervisor must enforce actual deadline/memory/cleanup.
No genuine encrypted-discovery capacity or end-to-end bounded work claim from synthetic pagination/tests.
